title: Every year since 1947, which country has given London the Christmas tree that stands in Trafalgar Square?

posts.facebook:
Every year since 1947, which country has given London the Christmas tree that stands in Trafalgar Square?

The answer is further down ↓

·
·
·

Answer: Norway. A thank-you for Britain's support during the Second World War. The tree is shipped from Oslo.
